scopeLabel: Xiaomi Japan manufacturer User Guide Index, phones/tablets Xiaomi/REDMI/POCO and Leica powered by Xiaomi, source category through POCO Pad, 2026-11-01

universe.populationMethod: Manufacturer's complete 306-link user-guide index: first contiguous 74 mobile-section links, remove explicitly generic software/safety (6) and separately identified case/pen/keyboard/photography kit accessories (7), collapse 2 case-variant duplicates 'Redmi Pad 2 4G' and 'REDMI Pad 2 4G' with identical href (1) -> 60 unique model guide entries. Maintain product category boundary at first REDMI Buds 5 Pro item (index 74).
universe.notes: The index explicitly names the full 60 phones and tablets with official manufacturer URLs. It is not proof that the JavaScript-rendered target contains an operating manual. The source includes the official Leica Leitzphone powered by Xiaomi under Xiaomi product category. Both carrier variant (Rakuten) and tablet radio variants are separate manufacturer-listed devices. Duplicate REDMI Pad 2 4G appears twice in original with identical slug; collapse only the duplicate while preserving evidence of two index positions. No full Xiaomi company-wide completion claim. Live GitHub Actions validated all 306 manufacturer index labels and independent Xiaomi CMS model names/order, bounded 74 mobile section entries, and all 60 unique smartphone/tablet models. 59 manufacturer CMS model-bound PDFs passed official HTTPS host, HTTP status, actual application/pdf bytes and %PDF- header (including Mi 10 Lite 5G after retries); Leica co-branded handset is held after independent Leica official multi-language PDF was found but final PDF bytes returned HTTP 502 from CI. The held model is retained, never published as an unverified direct manual.

review.notes: Never promote HTTP 200 generic Xiaomi Japan SPA shell to direct manual. Confirm manufacturer-controlled final guide or PDF and exact model identity. If unresolved after independent manufacturer paths, retain held. Scope includes 60 devices even when document checks fail.

liveReview.heldReason: Xiaomi official CMS links to own unresolved SPA route, independent Leica JP manufacturer downloads lists exact multilingual Quickstart Guide; direct Leica manufacturer PDF returned HTTP 502 from GitHub Actions after 3 retries, so NOT asserted as verified.
liveReview.pdfFormat: manufacturer-hosted product quick start / user guide PDF, do not assume full operating manual
